source: Joseph's order 2026-08-20: analyze the day's top banked wins topologically, structurally, geometrically; store them as trainers for future decisions.

the_shared_shape.topology: A single-session upward displacement of +8.7% to +33.3% within the last 8 sessions, standing 17% to 52% above the 20-session base. Entry at or just below the spike's top (0 to 10% below), 0-8 sessions after the spike. The harvest is the relaxation of that displacement back toward the base.
the_shared_shape.structure: ZERO ignitions between the spike and entry — in all five. The chain never confirmed the upward displacement: the move carried no structural support, so the field had nothing to hold it up. Channel deaths optional (0 in three, 1 in AGEN, 7 in ALGS); the invariant is the absent ignition, not the deaths.
the_shared_shape.geometry: At entry the body was intact and conducting: S_UF 0.78-0.89 (stable, not shattered), URF 0.45-0.61 (channel alive — a working channel for price to fall through), F_n 1.8-2.5 (force loaded). A dead channel is not the winning geometry; a LIVE channel under an unconfirmed displacement is.

the_contrast: Same day, the losing class: entries at the opening print into bodies already falling (BALY -7.8%, LEE, STLA). No displacement above base to relax; the morning reflex after a damage day ran against the entry. Different object entirely.
status: TRAINER RECORD, not a law. Five receipts. The readers cite this shape; a binding entry law needs a Method Gate declaration and receipts at scale. Grading of the open five-session positions continues.
